name: SpiderFoot domain footprint
description: Footprints a domain or IPv4 address with SpiderFoot OSS using a fixed set of passive, keyless domain, certificate, whois and network modules. Person-lookup modules are removed.
externalRestrictions: Public data sources apply their own limits; no API keys are used. Results are never marked confirmed because nothing is contacted. Anything about individuals (email addresses, usernames, people, social profiles) is discarded by design; the tool is run with a fixed allowlist, so those modules cannot be selected. It is a separate program, not part of Mayfair: Ghost downloads it into its tools folder on first use (checksum verified, then tested) or you point Ghost at your own copy. It is shown as installed only after its own self-test passes.
